read.thesis: Synchrony's Q1 shows purchase volume up 6% to $43.0B and charge-offs down 96bp to 5.42%, but loans were flat at $100.1B and CET1 fell to 12.7% amid a $6.5B buyback.

triggers.label: New $6.5B buyback, no expiry
triggers.quote: approved a new share repurchase program of up to $6.5 billion of the Company’s common stock, which commences in second quarter 2026

triggers.label: NCO rate down 96bp to 5.42%
triggers.quote: Net charge-offs as a percentage of total average loan receivables were 5.42% compared to 6.38% in the prior year

triggers.label: Loan receivables flat at $100.1B
triggers.quote: Loan receivables were flat at $100.1 billion

guidance.quote: a planned 13% increase in the quarterly cash dividend to $0.34 per share of common stock beginning in third quarter 2026

red_flags.label: CET1 down to 12.7% from 13.2%
red_flags.quote: The estimated Common Equity Tier 1 ratio was 12.7% compared to 13.2%

red_flags.label: Allowance ratio up vs Q4 and loans flat
red_flags.quote: The allowance for credit losses as a percentage of total period-end loan receivables was 10.42%, compared to 10.06% in the fourth quarter of 2025
